mapper.insert: insert into aftersale_request(req_no, order_id, user_id, req_type, reason, status, target_visit_date, target_timeslot_id, target_ticket_id) values(#{reqNo}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{reqType}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{targetVisitDate}, #{targetTimeslotId}, #{targetTicketId})
mapper.select: select * from aftersale_request where req_no=#{reqNo} limit 1
select * from aftersale_request where req_no=#{reqNo} limit 1 for update
select * from aftersale_request where user_id=#{userId} order by id desc
select * from aftersale_request order by id desc

select ar.* from aftersale_request ar join ticket_order o on o.id = ar.order_id join user_account u on u.id = o.user_id where 1=1 and u.phone like concat('%', #{userPhone}, '%') and ar.status = #{status} order by ar.id desc
